test_title: PYST 17: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 28 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The library sessions were __conducive__ for healthy discussions.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Unfavourable."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Conducive means making a certain situation or outcome likely or possible. (अनुकूल)
 
 
• Example: The quiet atmosphere of the library is conducive to study.
 
 
 
• Unfavourable means not favorable; contrary to one's interest or welfare. (प्रतिकूल)
 
 
• Example: The unfavourable weather conditions made it impossible to proceed with the outdoor event.
 
 

**Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Exclusive means restricted or limited to the person, group, or area concerned. (विशिष्ट)
 
• Integrated means combined or coordinated to form a whole. (समेकित)
 
• Invaluable means extremely useful; indispensable. (अमूल्य)
